requirementFit.summary: Rounds 1-2 verified the full requirement <-> acceptance <-> evidence mapping against the code: 4 requirements, 6 criteria, EV-BE-1/EV-FE-1, owners aligned with workstreams. All three operator asks (avatars via /files, backend stories contract, frontend consumption with uploads and viewed rings) are covered.

implementationQuality.summary: Stories module inside the chats feature (guard-safe, chats/history precedent; round-1 PR-1); write-sets cover every planned change including profile api.test.ts (round-2 R2-1) with BE/FE sets disjoint; AppState.stories weakly typed like the chats slice with no type imports from features into utils (round-2 R2-3); avatar_url as model properties with from_attributes responses; markViewed patches the Store slice synchronously before its POST and the page never writes stories props (round-1 PR-5).

evidenceQuality.summary: verify:all and guard --all --strict are the evidence commands; the alembic round-trip is an honest manual evidence note against compose PostgreSQL (verify:backend runs pytest + alembic heads only); adapter/controller/page tests pin the contract deterministically; manual checklist items are explicitly not gate claims.

residualRisk.summary: Access widening is limited to the chat_id IS NULL branch (regression-pinned outsider-403 for chat attachments); owner-only chat avatars; image/* whitelist and size limits reuse the existing validation; stacked base documented with a rebase contingency. Round 4 confirmed the intent fields rewritten by assignment (spec and manifest byte-identical) and revision counters at 4.

rounds.summary: Full review of revision 1: 2 MAJOR (cross-feature guard conflict for a separate features/stories module; write-set holes for chats/profile ports and chat repository/service), 3 MINOR (alembic quality floor not provable by the gate, avatar_url population mechanism unspecified, stories double-source race), 3 NIT (chat.hbs in write-set without a task, chat id source ambiguity, tight budgets).

Full review of revision 2: round-1 remediation verified against the code and confirmed (PR-1..PR-8 all closed or confirmed); new MAJOR write-set hole (profile api.test.ts pins changeAvatar-unsupported and would go red), 2 MINOR (stale features/stories wording in intent fields; Store.ts type-import ambiguity), 3 NIT (get_chat mislabelled hand-built, StoryDto.alt without a source, reviewedRevision stale).

Confirm pass over revision 3: R2-1 (profile api.test.ts added to the write-set with a reworked contract test), R2-3 (AppState.stories weakly typed like the chats slice, StoryDto in the module, no type imports from features into Store.ts), R2-4, R2-5 and R2-6 closed and verified against the code; PR3-1 (MINOR) left open — the R2-2 string replacement silently did not apply, leaving 'features/stories module' in the two intent fields while the review request claimed its removal.

Point confirm over PR3-1 on revision 4: both intent fields rewritten by synchronous assignment (byte-identical, 'src/features/chats/stories/'), revision counters at 4/4/4, package grep leaves only the legitimate plan.md anti-feature rationale and finding quotes. No new findings; freeze authorized.

Controller revision after round 4: acceptance-criteria.md AC-PROCESS row reformatted to the verifier's machine-readable requirements column (backticked requirement IDs instead of 'all'; content unchanged) and planRevision raised to 5. READY_TO_FREEZE carried over from the round-4 confirm of the same substance.
